title: Mortality Risk Stratification Among Critically Ill Patients with Documented Hypoferremia: Analysis Code and Model
description: Versioned analysis code, non-patient aggregate results, plotting source, documentation, and a research model bundle accompanying a multi-cohort retrospective study of mortality risk stratification among ICU patients with documented biochemical hypoferremia. Raw and derived patient-level data, identifiers, row-level outcomes, and row-level prediction probabilities are not redistributed.
